description:

Danny and McGarrett work on their relationship as they pursue a woman who escaped after a diamond robbery.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:

When Chin and Danny are taken into custody over past deadly transgressions, McGarrett turns to Joe for help.

title: Hawaii Five-0

McGarrett and Odell come under assault at the barbershop while trying to protect a young man being hunted by a gang; Jerry is accused of a series of home invasions.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:

The wife of one of Grover's closest friends falls to her death; Dr. Shaw and Danny are stuck in an elevator with a body that needs processing.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:

After a murder takes place at a convention of Elvis impersonators, the victim's body is stolen; Gabriel asks Chin for help.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:

When a dead woman is found in a hotel suite belonging to three married, hungover men, the team must help them retrace their steps as they try to remember what happened -- and find the killer.

During a solo outrigger trip, Kono encounters bad weather and must fight for her life; the Five-0 investigates a man in trouble for cooking meth.

description:

description:

On the eve of Adam and Kono's wedding, the Five-0 must stop a fanatical patriot who wants to detonate stolen nuclear warheads and place the blame on a terrorist -- resulting in a new war on terror.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:

The team investigates a centuries-old pirate story involving buried treasure; Gabriel kidnaps Kono and Adam on the morning after their wedding.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:

A bomb squad is attacked, and the culprit threatens to detonate hidden explosive devices unless arsonist Jason Sinclair (Randy Couture) is released from prison.

description:

A scuba diver is killed with a gun that was used in a recent murder; McGarrett gets ready to propose to Catherine.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:

A wealthy recluse's corpse is found in a field with almost $1 million in counterfeit bills; Adam is abducted and forced to torture one of Gabriel's men.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:

The team questions members of a stunt biker gang when a killer escapes by jumping his motorcycle from roof to roof; the team prepares for Tough Mudder.

description:

description:

Toby is brought in to investigate some corrupt cops, but finds himself in over his head when one of them ends up dead from a suspected drug overdose.

title: NCIS: New Orleans

description:

The NCIS team investigates a deadly bombing at a military museum event with over 1,000 people in attendance.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S05 E23 — The River Styx, Part 1
Pride and LaSalle travel to war-torn South Ossetia to locate an FBI agent who was kidnapped during a failed mission to apprehend the leader of Apollyon, the underground spy network responsible for murdering Pride's father.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S05 E24 — The River Styx, Part II
After tracking Apollyon, a deadly underground spy network, to war-torn South Ossetia, Pride is separated from the team and faces grave danger; in order to save Pride, the NCIS team must locate a mole who continues to feed information to Apollyon.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

Pride must cut his vacation short when Hannah is suspended for breaking protocol during a joint investigation with the FBI.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

A Navy pilot says she saw an unidentified object prior to a private plane crash; Pride suffers from insomnia and nightmares as a result of being kidnapped and drugged last year.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S06 E03 — Bad Apple
Pride travels to New York City after new DNA evidence is linked to a 20-year-old cold case from his past.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

The team uncovers a sinister plot by a private detention center contracted by the government to house undocumented immigrants; LaSalle and Sebastian travel to Alabama to search for LaSalle's missing brother.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S06 E05 — Spies & Lies
Navy Lt. Max Landry asks the New Orleans field office for help when he suspects his girlfriend is a spy; LaSalle faces another devastating dead end as he searches for his brother's last known whereabouts.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

LaSalle hopes to avenge his brother's murder by tracking a drug ring in Alabama he believes is responsible; when Pride assists with the case, he crosses paths with Eddie Barrett, an elusive individual who knows more than he is sharing.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

Following a natural gas explosion at a movie theater, the team discovers the gas company has been hacked, and more explosions could be triggered.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

Sebastian calls the team to assist with a possible kidnapping case when a dignitary's son he was assigned to protect disappears from a local concert venue.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

After Eddie Barrett provides an alibi witness, Pride and the team are more determined than ever to find a break in the case and avenge LaSalle's murder.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

Pride is cut off from the team and backed into a corner after the investigation into Eddie Barrett uncovers a malicious plot.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

The team is concerned when Sebastian becomes unreachable while undercover as a new recruit.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

The team must track down a mysterious female assassin responsible for murders in Athens, Rome and London; Wade's son begs her to allow him to go on a police ride-along for an article he's writing on a youth outreach program.

description:

The team investigates the murder of a JAG captain who was discovered at home by his daughter, the only heir to his large estate; Sebastian is intimidated when he is put in charge of a team on his first day of training.

description:

When Pride is unable to sleep due to continuing nightmares about the mysterious man in the red suit; he undergoes a specialized treatment to help him figure out the man's identity; an arrogant new officer joins the team.

description:

description:

description:

A Secret Service agent is murdered while the president is traveling to Oahu; as Thanksgiving approaches, McGarrett's Aunt Deb (Carol Burnett) visits and shares a stunning secret.

description:
